mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(d.id) as enabledDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.last_seen_time) <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as onlineDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.last_seen_time) > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as offlineDevices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ua.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN ua.device_id ELSE NULL END) as alarmingDevices, COALESCE(unhandled_counts.count, 0) as unhandledAlerts, COALESCE(today_counts.count, 0) as todayAlerts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.last_seen_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) THEN d.id ELSE NULL END) as last5MinReportDevices FROM devices d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT device_id FROM alerts WHERE status IN ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING') ) ua ON ua.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM alerts WHERE DATE(created_time) = CURDATE() ) today_counts ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM alerts WHERE status IN ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING') ) unhandled_counts ON 1=1 WHERE d.enabled = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devices d LEFT JOIN warehouse_areas wa ON wa.id = d.area_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MAX(alert_level) as highest_alert_level, COUNT(*) as alert_count FROM alerts WHERE status IN ('UNHANDLED', 'HANDLING') GROUP BY device_id ) ua ON ua.device_id = d.id WHERE d.enabled = 1
AND d.area_id = #{areaId}
AND ( (#{online} = 1 OR #{online} = true OR #{online} = 'true') AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.last_seen_time)) <= 120 OR (#{online} = 0 OR #{online} = false OR #{online} = 'false') AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.last_seen_time)) > 120 )
AND ua.alert_count IS NOT NULL
AND (d.device_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as time, AVG(temperature) as temperature, AVG(humidity) as humidity FROM sensor_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND data_time BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(data_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') ORDER BY data_time ASC
